name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 29 – Am 37
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 29b. Insists that the application of the DSA and the designation of a platform as a very large online platform must be based exclusively on objective and quantitative criteria, in particular the number of active users, and not on the nature of the political opinions expressed on that platform; reiterates that the fight against foreign interference must never serve as a pretext for censoring lawful political content, including content critical of the EU institutions;
